Ne.name: Extraverted Intuition
Ne.description: Noticing trends and possibilities in a reality filled with unknown opportunities
Ne.descriptionLong: The function of possibility — building associative maps of what could exist rather than what does.
Ne.descriptionBehaviour: Together, Ne is the capacity to read the external world for what it *could become* rather than what it currently is.

Ni.name: Introverted Intuition
Ni.description: Seeing through distortions; having hunches of unfounded truth; the source of unknown ideas
Ni.descriptionLong: The function of long-range pattern — sensing where things are heading before the evidence is in.
Ni.descriptionBehaviour: Together, Ni is the capacity to perceive the *inner logic of unfolding events* — to sense how a situation is developing and where it must inevitably lead, independent of immediate observable facts.

Se.name: Extraverted Sensing
Se.description: Living in the moment and accepting reality with a just-react response
Se.descriptionLong: The function of physical and social dominance — an immediate, commanding presence in the here and now.
Se.descriptionBehaviour: Together, Se is the capacity to perceive the *immediate physical and social landscape* — who holds power, what is real, what is happening right now, and how to act decisively within it.

Si.name: Introverted Sensing
Si.description: Anchoring oneself to safe bets in a world that feels inherently chaotic
Si.descriptionLong: the function of settled experience. Physical comfort, wellbeing, and a keen sense of when things drift from the known and proven.
Si.descriptionBehaviour: Together, Si is the capacity to perceive how comfortable and settled experience is, physically and in daily life, and to notice whenever it drifts from what is known and trusted.

Fe.name: Extraverted Ethics
Fe.description: Concern for the roles people play and how we relate in a shared social world
Fe.descriptionLong: The function of emotional atmosphere — an active awareness of any group's feeling-state and a drive to shape it.
Fe.descriptionBehaviour: Together, Fe is the capacity to *perceive, generate and manage emotional atmosphere* — to read the emotional state of a room and to deliberately influence it.

Fi.name: Introverted Ethics
Fi.description: Concern for harmony between self and others; the rational attitude of moral values
Fi.descriptionLong: The function of personal moral conviction — a deep, stable sense of what is right that needs no external validation.
Fi.descriptionBehaviour: Together, Fi is the capacity to *perceive and evaluate the quality of personal relationships and inner moral states* — a quiet, stable inner map of who people are, what they mean, and whether their actions align with deeply-held values.

Te.name: Extraverted Logic
Te.description: Seeking practical, externally predictable results through decisive decision-making
Te.descriptionLong: The function of results — converting possibility into measurable outcome through decisive, efficient action.
Te.descriptionBehaviour: Together, Te is the capacity to perceive *what works, what is factually accurate and how to organise external activity efficiently* — a rational evaluation of the objective, practical world.

Ti.name: Introverted Logic
Ti.description: Seeking to understand how something works structurally; demanding complete underlying knowledge
Ti.descriptionLong: The function of internal logical structure — building precise, self-consistent frameworks and rejecting what doesn't fit.
Ti.descriptionBehaviour: Together, Ti is the capacity to perceive *whether a system, argument or set of ideas is internally consistent* — a rational evaluation of structural integrity independent of external facts.
